_meta.purpose: HOME-BASED BUSINESS validity set (n=50). The actual lead-magnet population: thin public evidence, sole operators, statutory scale caps. Tests the 0.9.0 display_floor change on the population where evidence coverage is genuinely lowest.

form.category: Bespoke creative work made at home: florals, calligraphy, embroidery
form.positioning_sentence: Bespoke calligraphy and hand embroidery with live-event work.
form.differentiator: Bespoke calligraphy and hand embroidery with live-event work - I attend the event and personalise items for guests as they arrive, so each one leaves with something made in front of them.
form.undercut_on: Everything is made by hand by one person, so I cannot take high-volume corporate orders and my lead times are long.
